notes.title: Trading cards now available!!
notes.notes: As so heavily requested, SpaceRoads trading cards are now available to collect!

notes.title: New version 1.03!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We have just uploaded version 1.03 for Mac and Windows!

What have we done? A fair bit!

- Added the ability to skip the introduction (the intro was initially a method for preloading everything but now we've done some voodoo and you are now able to skip the intro)

- Squashed some bugs

- Added a new feature that will show you all the times you died in a level (as you have been playing that level, if you exit the level and re-enter the level the previous die points are deleted)

Let me know what you think of that feature, I'm thinking about expanding it into a scoring system....

Anyways, what else is coming? SpaceRoads Classic Pack!

There are going to be more levels coming soon that are more Skyroads than ever! Don't fret though, as always the updated levels will be totally free!

notes.title: Contest Alert!
notes.notes:
I cannot begin to thank everyone for the support of SpaceRoads!

I am so happy that everyone is enjoying it as much as we have enjoyed creating it. 

With this in mind, as mentioned before, we are going to be adding more levels, and more content to increase the playability of SpaceRoads.

Which is where this announcement comes in, we are having a contest! 

First, we are inviting all Steam owners to enter this contest by submitting an idea or a theme/environment for a level. The ones we like, we will use, and put your name in the credits.

Those who are extra creative and want to send designs of the levels are more than welcome to do so!

We are also welcoming ideas for ship designs! So send those in too!

Send us your ideas to miguel@wurdindustries.com!

We will pick 3 lucky entrants at random and work in tandem with you as we design the new levels.

We can't wait to see what you have in mind! And are excited for the future of SpaceRoads.

Contest ends Saturday December 2nd 2017.

Thanks again for everything!
